messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on the nearest weekday when it lands on a weekend), giving you a 3‑day break that includes the weekend.

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 2023 was a Sunday; the holiday is observed on Monday, Jan 2. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (most provinces) | Family Day is the third Monday in February in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador, Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, and Quebec. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is always on a Friday; the weekend is Fri‑Sun. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is the Monday preceding May 25; it is a federal holiday. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day | Canada Day falls on Saturday, Jul 1; it is observed on Monday, Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day falls on Saturday, Nov 11; it is observed on Monday, Nov 13. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas Day is on Monday, Dec 25. |

### Quick Reference

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) – observed Jan 2 | Jan 1–2 |
| Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18–20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | May 20–22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) – observed Jul 3 | Jul 1–3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2–4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7–9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) – observed Nov 13 | Nov 11–13 |
| Christmas | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23–25 |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.), but the table above lists the federal holidays that affect the entire country.  
> • If you’re targeting a specific province, you’ll want to add that province’s unique holidays to this list.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for scheduling your long‑weekend getaways!
